Use of AI tools: A language model (DeepSeek, deepseek-chat) drafted founder, reason and board codes from filings and news, each with a quoted source; every code on a founder, fraud or personal conduct was then reviewed against the sources. No second human coder has checked the codes. The author designed the study and is responsible for the content.
jf_export.standfirst: From six weeks before the announcement to the day after, a founder's firm trails its industry by {{fv.founder.ind.slideann.ret.mean|abs}} and its three closest competitors by {{fv.founder.pr3.slideann.ret.mean|abs}} when the board dismisses the founder, most of it before the news. Within five years {{exit.forced.bankruptcy_5y}} of firms that dismiss their CEO for reasons other than fraud go bankrupt, against {{exit.retired.bankruptcy_5y}} after a retirement.

standfirst: When boards dismiss founder CEOs, the firms have usually fallen behind already. This paper prices that loss against the market, the industry and the closest competitors, and asks what is left for an investor once the news is public.
